instruction: I want to reduce the maximum volume in VLC to prevent accidentally setting it too loud. Can you set the maximum volume slider to 100% in VLC?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's max volume to 100% (qt-max-volume=100 in vlcrc config file). Nearly identical to original task but with different target value (100% vs 200%).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-appropriate location (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses the vlcrc config file and extracts the qt-max-volume setting
Metric properly handles default value (125) when setting is not present in config
Metric correctly compares extracted value against expected value (100), with proper type conversion
Expected value (100) is semantically correct - represents 100% max volume as requested in instruction
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to flush config changes to disk before evaluation
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (set max volume to 100%) and evaluator checks exactly that
Data flow is sound: User completes task -> Postconfig ensures config written -> Getter reads config -> Metric verifies setting
